comment: GENERATED by Davoice_LLM_Training/tools/export_app_h2_tools.py - do not edit. h2 wording (no example values) of carToolDefinitions.json for models trained/benchmarked with it (VW demo ft7e). Same names, order, arguments and handlers; only descriptions differ.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Starts navigation to a destination: an address, a place or point of interest, or the user's own home or workplace.

destination.description: Where to go, exactly as the user named it (an address with its number, or a place name). Only when the user means their own home or their own workplace: home or work

tools.name: find_along_route
tools.description: Finds a place along the route or nearby: gas station, EV charger, parking and so on.

detail.description: Extra wishes, only if the user said any

tools.name: get_trip_eta
tools.description: Says the estimated arrival time and remaining distance of the current trip.

tools.name: set_route_avoid
tools.description: Reroutes the current trip to avoid something.

tools.name: set_temperature
tools.description: Sets the cabin temperature to a value, or changes it by some degrees (warmer +, cooler -), for one zone or all.

temperature.description: Absolute target in degrees: the number the user said for the temperature

change.description: Relative step only, in degrees: positive = warmer, negative = cooler. Not for a target value

unit.description: Only if the user said it

zone.description: all unless the user named a side: driver = the user's own side; passenger = the front passenger's side; rear = back seats

tools.name: comfort_feeling
tools.description: The user says they feel cold or hot: the car adjusts climate and seat heating or cooling.

tools.name: set_fan_speed
tools.description: Sets the climate fan speed to a level (1 to 7), or changes it by some levels (faster +, slower -).

level.description: Absolute fan level 1-7: the level the user said; maximum = 7, minimum = 1

change.description: Relative step only, in levels: positive = faster, negative = slower (stronger / weaker without a number = +1 / -1). Not for a level

tools.name: set_airflow
tools.description: Sets where the air blows.

tools.name: set_defrost
tools.description: Turns the windshield defrost or the rear window defogger on or off.

on.description: true = turn on (defrost/defog), false = turn off (stop defrosting)

tools.name: set_window
tools.description: Opens or closes windows, fully, halfway or just a crack.

window.description: Which window: driver = the user's own, passenger = front passenger, rear_left / rear_right, all = every window. Ask if the user did not say which

position.description: open (lower it), close (raise it), half, crack (a little)

tools.name: open_door
tools.description: Opens a car door, not a window (abrir a porta).

door.description: Which door: driver = the user's own, passenger, rear_left / rear_right; all if the user did not name one

tools.name: close_doors
tools.description: Shuts the car doors that are open, not the windows (fechar as portas).

door.description: Which door: driver = the user's own, passenger, rear_left / rear_right; all if the user did not name one

tools.name: lock_car
tools.description: Locks the car doors (lock the car / trancar o carro, travar as portas).

door.description: Which door: driver = the user's own, passenger, rear_left / rear_right; all if the user did not name one

tools.name: unlock_car
tools.description: Unlocks the car doors (unlock the car / destrancar o carro, destravar as portas).

door.description: Which door: driver = the user's own, passenger, rear_left / rear_right; all if the user did not name one

tools.name: set_sunroof
tools.description: Opens, tilts or closes the sunroof.

tools.name: set_sunshade
tools.description: Opens or closes the sunshade.

tools.name: set_trunk
tools.description: Opens or closes the trunk (rear) or the frunk (front trunk).

tools.name: set_charge_port
tools.description: Opens or closes the charging port cover.

tools.name: rotate_screen
tools.description: Rotates the center screen between landscape and portrait.

orientation.description: Only if the user said it

tools.name: set_seat_climate
tools.description: Seat heater or ventilation for one seat. Levels: 1 = low, 2 = medium, 3 = high.

seat.description: driver = the user's own seat (default), passenger = front passenger seat, rear_left / rear_right

feature.description: heater = warm the seat, ventilation = cool / ventilate the seat

level.description: off, low (1), medium (2), high (3 or maximum)

tools.name: set_seat_massage
tools.description: Turns seat massage on or off, or picks a massage mode.

seat.description: driver = the user's own seat (default), passenger, rear_left / rear_right

on.description: true to turn on, false to turn off

mode.description: Massage mode number, if the user said one

tools.name: set_steering_wheel_heater
tools.description: Turns the heated steering wheel on or off.

on.description: true to turn on, false to turn off

tools.name: set_cabin_lights
tools.description: Ambient lighting (with an optional color) or the reading lights, on or off.

on.description: true to turn on, false to turn off

color.description: Ambient color in English, only if the user said one

tools.name: play_media
tools.description: Plays music or audio: an artist, song, album, genre, playlist or podcast.

query.description: What to play, as the user said it

tools.name: tune_radio
tools.description: Tunes the radio: FM or AM to a frequency, or DAB digital radio.

band.description: fm unless the user said AM or DAB

frequency.description: Only the number the user said: FM in MHz with one decimal, AM in kHz

tools.name: set_audio_source
tools.description: Switches the audio source.

tools.name: set_audio_focus
tools.description: Focuses the sound on one seat (sound-source localization), or back to everyone.

tools.name: set_volume
tools.description: Turns the volume up or down a step, sets it to a level (0 to 30), or mutes or unmutes it.

action.description: up (louder), down (quieter), set (a number was said), mute, unmute (sound back)

level.description: Only with set: the number the user said, 0-30

tools.name: call_contact
tools.description: Calls a contact from the phone's contacts.

name.description: Contact name as the user said it

number_type.description: Only if the user said it

tools.name: manage_call
tools.description: Answers or declines the incoming call, or hangs up the current one.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Sends a text message to a contact. Needs the contact and the message text.

message.description: The message text, word for word

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Reads the unread messages aloud.

tools.name: get_vehicle_status
tools.description: Reports vehicle status: range left, fuel level, battery level, average consumption of this trip, tire pressure or warning lights.

tools.name: activate_scenario
tools.description: Starts a scenario mode that sets several systems at once: smoking (driver window open a little, air extraction), rest (seat reclines, lights dim, sunshades close, mild climate), rain (closes all windows and the sunroof), car_wash (folds mirrors, closes windows, wipers off).
